Software Engineering Intern — Campus Hiring

We are seeking a Bachelor of Technology or Computer Science student for a software engineering internship. The intern will build reliable Python and FastAPI services, collaborate with React developers, design SQL and PostgreSQL data access, and document REST APIs. Responsibilities include implementing testable backend features, reviewing pull requests, deploying containerized services with Docker and AWS, and communicating progress with the placement engineering team.

Required skills: Python, FastAPI, SQL, PostgreSQL, Git, and Docker. Preferred skills: React, TypeScript, AWS, machine learning, Azure, Kubernetes, and data analysis. Candidates should have internship, project, or equivalent hands-on experience and be graduating from an accredited bachelor degree program.
